comment: Non-weekend company holidays, excluded (along with Saturdays and Sundays, which are always excluded automatically) from every working-day ageing calculation across the whole site - Projects dashboard, Production dashboard, and any future one - see src/utils.py -> working_days_between(). One 'YYYY-MM-DD' string per holiday date in the 'dates' list below; order doesn't matter, and no code changes are ever needed to add more - just add dates here and re-run the pipeline.
weekend_comment: Weekends are hard-coded as Saturday+Sunday in src/utils.py (WEEKEND_WEEKDAYS) since that's confirmed against the DEE Piping Systems Thailand company calendar - change that constant, not this file, if the weekend pattern ever changes.
2026_comment: The 2026 DEE Piping Systems (Thailand) calendar was reviewed pixel-by-pixel on 2026-08-06 and has exactly 15 non-weekend holiday dates: Jan 1, Jan 2, Mar 3, Apr 13-15, May 1, Jun 3, Jul 28, Aug 12, Oct 13, Oct 23, Dec 7, Dec 31 (14 dates, colour-coded 'Traditional Holiday' on the calendar), plus Jan 16 (colour-coded differently, as 'Sports Day & New Year' per the calendar's own legend, but not named in the calendar's own written holiday list - the project owner asked to confirm what Jan 16 actually is before adding any of these 15 dates here). Left empty (dates: []) per the project owner's explicit instruction on 2026-08-06 to start with weekends-only and add this list in once confirmed - see the chat where this file was introduced for the full pixel-verified date list ready to paste in.
